messages.content:
You are alone in a stone farmstead at the end of the season. You are trying to stay alive.

Say what you do in as few words as possible: a verb, and the thing it acts on.

These are the words that work. Nothing else does:

    go north / go south / go east / go west
    look
    inventory
    examine <thing>
    take <thing>
    drop <thing>
    open <thing>
    close <thing>
    eat <thing>

Reply with the command only.

-= Hall =-
A bare hall with a swept floor. The store lies north and the yard east.
